'''Tara Jayne Sands''' is an American voice actress who has been in English-language [[dub]]s of {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}. She is sometimes credited as simply '''Tara Jayne''' or '''Tara Sands'''. She is currently affiliated with CESD Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Sands was a voice actor on {{aniseries|PTS}} starting with its [[S01|first season]]. She had provided the voices of many [[Character of the day|characters of the day]] until the end of [[S07|the seventh season]]. After her departure, archived audio was used to voice all of the {{p|Bulbasaur}} that appeared in the show (most frequently [[May's Bulbasaur]]) until [[Michele Knotz]] took on the role. Her most prominent roles on ''Pokémon the Series'' are that of [[Ritchie]] and [[Ash's Bulbasaur]].

In 2016, Sands lent her voice to characters in [[Pokémon Generations]]. She returned to ''Pokémon the Series'' in ''[[S23|Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]'', now being credited under her full name. She voices [[Professor Cerise's Yamper]].

Aside from her work on Pokémon, she was also the co-host of Fridays on {{wp|Cartoon Network}} until 2007. Sands currently lives in Los Angeles, working independently.

In 2023, Sands started a Podcast series called ''4Kids Flashback'' where she and her co-host Steve Yurko share memories and behind-the-scenes stories about working at [[4Kids Entertainment]].
